messages:
lina: dropping critique notes from this morning's design review. uploaded a 'minmax pinch + scheduler' prototype: https://figma.redwood/minmax-scheduler-v1

omar: saw it. pinch is slick for quick adj. question: if pinch raises min above global SLO, do we auto-clamp or warn?

lina: plan: apply change immediately, show non-blocking inline banner: "SLO constraint: your min exceeds global target. Preview impact." not blocking.

tas: a11y: pinch gesture isn't keyboard friendly. need explicit controls: plus/minus buttons, numeric input, and stepper. add hint text: "use arrow keys to adjust" and aria-describedby.

maya: UX: added micro SLO tiles above pool cards. if pinch breaches tile, tile pulses and shows tooltip: "Min above SLO: availability may drop". also added proposed copy for clamp banner.

kevin: keyboard flow: micro-tiles must be focusable. announce state changes with aria-live=polite: "Availability risk increased for Pool X". pinch control should expose aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext like "Min: 2 GPUs, Max: 6 GPUs".

a11y-bot: contrast check: pinch handler label contrast fails AA on small screens. recommend darker stroke or 4.5:1 contrast for text-on-handle.

lina: noted. scheduler: small timeline scrubber to set start/end windows (e.g., 10:00-10:15). shows est cost delta. label: "Schedule temporary capacity". confirm CTA: "Schedule burst".

omar: UX Q: if multiple pools have overlapping bursts, how do we visualize conflicts? mocked stacked bars per timeslot. could also show a textual summary fallback.

tas: textual fallback required for SR users: keep a simple list in DOM: "10:00-10:15: Pool A +2 GPUs, Pool B +1 GPU (total +3)". screen readers read that instead of heatmap.

kevin: drag/reorder in affinity view: announce "Pool A moved to affinity group 2". ensure touch targets >=44px. pinch hit area should be larger to avoid accidental drags. respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations.

lina: copy asks: short label for pinch = "Min/Max". tooltip: "Adjust minimum and maximum reserved GPUs". clamp banner microcopy: "Suggested: lower min or increase global SLO".

a11y-bot: provide SR snippet for scheduler confirm: aria-live=assertive "Burst scheduled for Pool A 10:00-10:15; est cost +0.9%". dialog must use role=dialog and aria-modal=true.

maya: implementation notes: keep full metadata in DOM even if hidden visually (sr-only) so SR users get context when compacting. compact mode toggle in header; keyboard shortcut: 'c' (aria-keyshortcuts).

omar: heatmap fallback list prototype is in figma comments. i'll add sample strings.

kevin: i'll run keyboard + SR pass tomorrow AM and validate announcements for reorder and pinch. also test pinch with screen magnifier.

lina: timeline: will push v1.2 with keyboard steppers, SR snippets, contrast fixes, and fallback list by EOD. please drop inline figma comments. :sparkles:
